wiki.title: Herron Gaston
wiki.extract: Herron Keyon Gaston (born June 11, 1994) is an American businessman, pastor, academic, author who has self-published four books, and politician who currently serves as a member of the Connecticut State Senate, where he serves as the Deputy President Pro Tempore, for the Democratic Party representing the 23rd district encompassing parts of Bridgeport and Stratford. Sen. Gaston is also a close cousin of Derwin James Jr. of the Los Angeles Chargers.
